character.name: A 2D pixel art character sprite of an old Vietnamese merchant man, full body, top-down 2D RPG game perspective, facing forward, straight front view standing pose. The character anatomy and style must perfectly match the reference: grey hair styled into a high, rounded traditional topknot bun ("búi tóc củ tỏi") with a small white hairpin visible. He has an elderly weathered face with a short neat grey beard and mustache. He wears a simple, rustic, short-sleeved loose brown traditional collarless shirt ("áo cánh") that opens slightly at the neck, over loose dark charcoal cropped trousers that reach below the knees. Completely barefoot with blocky pixel feet. Thick clean pixel outlines, flat 16-bit colors, no modern gradients, perfectly isolated on a solid pure black background, functional RPG game asset.
